data_description.ev_charger_switch_entity: Switch that starts/pauses the wallbox charging. When the available current drops below the minimum, charging is paused instead of dropping below the minimum (which would still draw the minimum and trip the meter); it resumes once the current is back above the minimum. Leave empty if your wallbox already stops when the pause current is written.
data_description.current_steps: Comma-separated Ampere values (e.g. 6, 8, 10, 13, 16). Current is rounded down to the nearest allowed step. Leave empty to use every integer from min to max.
data_description.ocpp_cp_id: Must match exactly (case included) the identity configured in the charger. Leave it empty to accept the first charger that connects: it is the quickest way to find out which ID it actually uses.
data_description.allowed_bands: None selected: charging happens in every band.
